Jul 11, 2022

## [TRADE CLIENTS BEWARE …I am so sad to write this because I…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/62cc64af0c20b4453c367d12)
I am so sad to write this because I love the collections that LuLu and Georgia carry but the customer service here is UNACCEPTABLE. 

I have been a decorator for over 30 years and I have never had a company that works with the trade so dismissive and irresponsible

My marble top table arrived broken in 4 large pieces. After months of sending photographs of the table, the boxes it arrived in, the crate… I was told I would receive a replacement. This was over a year ago.

My attempted calls and messages are never returned nor are my emails. 

I’m sure they are fine to work with, but Candace, who works with the trade clients is not some one I would recommend working with. Ever.

July 11, 2022

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 11, 2022

Hi Vicki, we apologize for any negative experience you've had! We don't have any correspondence or order history of a marble table, but we're happy to look this matter. Please send us an email to trade@luluandgeorgia.com with your order number and our Trade Team will be in touch shortly.
